GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender participation and annual-report domestic/export splits are not public on any page I could reach: thecompanycheck.com and zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403, tofler.in returned HTTP 404, and the DuckDuckGo search backend was unavailable ("searx: Connection refused") for every query, so no GST or tender page could be located. note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L rows with BOL numbers 1014694, 9960180, 1101853, 9729451 and 9895248 show real outbound shipments from Nhava Sheva, Mundra and Sahar Air Cargo to Germany and Russia in February 2026, so the company is an active exporter of p-sulphanilic acid, optical brighteners and oil-well chemicals. Revenue and export volume figures: null — ImportKey free view gives shipment counts only, no value or tonnage, and I did not invent any. Domestic (India) supply evidence: null / unknown for the reasons above; this should be re-checked with a working search backend or a paid GST/tender source before any domestic-supply conclusion is drawn. No rejection grounds: the entity is live and actively shipping, and the HS mismatch is a correction, not a disqualifier.
